title: The Long-Term Earnings' Effects of a Credit Market Disruption
title_zh: 信贷市场中断对长期收入的影响
authors: Adamopoulou, Effrosyni, De Philippis, Marta, Sette, Enrico, Viviano, Eliana
official: 来源期次 American Economic Journal: Macroeconomics · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: Using a unique matched bank-employer-employee administrative dataset for Italy, we construct an exogenous firm-level measure of exposure to the credit shock during the Global Financial Crisis, based on pre-crisis firm-bank relationships. We track outcomes for firms and workers up to 11 years after the shock. More exposed firms experience persistently lower growth in bank credit, which in turn leads to weaker investment and employment dynamics due to capital-labor complementarity. More capital-intensive firms and their workers suffer the most. Displaced workers reallocate primarily to less capital-intensive firms, incurring persistent losses in labor earnings.
abstract_zh: 利用意大利独特的银行-雇主-雇员匹配行政数据集，我们基于危机前的企业-银行关系，构建了全球金融危机期间企业层面信贷冲击暴露度的外生衡量指标。我们追踪了冲击发生后长达11年的企业与工人结果。信贷暴露度更高的企业持续面临更低的银行信贷增长，进而因资本-劳动互补性导致投资与就业动态疲弱。资本密集度更高的企业及其工人遭受的损失最为严重。被解雇的工人主要重新配置到资本密集度较低的企业，并承受持久的劳动收入损失。

title: Concentration in Product Markets
authors: C. Lanier Benkard, Ali Yurukoglu, Anthony Lee Zhang
abstract: This paper measures concentration in narrowly defined product markets for a broad range of consumer goods and services in the United States from 1994 to 2019. We document two main empirical facts. First, concentration levels are high. Of the markets in our sample, 44.4 percent are “highly concentrated” as defined by US regulators. Second, market concentration has been decreasing since 1994. The median HHI falls from 2,362 to 2,045. These findings stand in stark contrast to the prior literature, which uses market definitions that are aggregated to a level that is typically too broad to accurately reflect competition in consumer markets. (JEL D43, L13, M37, R32)
abstract_zh: 本文以1994年至2019年美国广泛消费品与服务市场为对象，在狭义产品市场层面测度市场集中度。我们揭示了两项主要实证发现：第一，市场集中度水平较高。按美国监管机构定义，样本中44.4%的市场属于"高度集中"市场。第二，自1994年以来市场集中度持续下降，赫芬达尔-赫希曼指数中位数从2,362降至2,045。这些发现与既有文献形成鲜明对比——既有研究采用的市场定义通常过于宽泛，难以准确反映消费品市场的竞争状况。(JEL D43, L13, M37, R32)

title: Systematic Forecast Errors from Extreme Weather Events in Credit Risk Models
title_zh: 极端天气事件导致的信用风险模型系统性预测误差
abstract: Extreme weather events generate systematic forecast errors in credit risk models. Using proprietary loan-level data covering approximately 250,000 corporate loans over 2012–2023, we find that exposure to extreme weather significantly predicts realized default rates after conditioning on model-implied probabilities. Effects are stronger for early-year exposures and reflect persistent regional vulnerability rather than transitory fluctuations. These results suggest that omitted climate risk factors contribute to systematic model miscalibration, robust across specifications. More broadly, when relevant weather events are excluded, forecast errors may become systematic rather than idiosyncratic, with implications for model design and the efficient allocation of credit.

title: Measuring inflation expectations: How the response scale shapes density forecasts
title_zh: 衡量通胀预期：响应量表如何塑造密度预测
authors: Christoph K. Becker, Peter Duersch, Thomas A. Eife
abstract: In density forecasts, respondents are asked to assign probabilities to a response scale with pre‐specified ranges of inflation. In two large‐scale experiments, one conducted in the US and one in Germany, we show how the specifics of the response scale determine the results: Shifting, compressing, or expanding the scale leads to shifted, compressed, and expanded forecasts. Quantifying this effect using the scale most widely used among central banks, we find that mean forecast, uncertainty, and disagreement can vary by several percentage points. Density forecasts may severely misestimate the “true” inflation expectations, and may generate spurious changes in reported inflation uncertainty. The analysis suggests several ways to reduce this bias.
abstract_zh: 在密度预测中，受访者需对预设通胀区间的响应量表分配概率。通过在美国和德国开展的两项大规模实验，我们揭示了响应量表的具体设计如何决定预测结果：移动、压缩或扩展量表会导致预测值相应偏移、压缩或扩展。采用央行最广泛使用的量表量化这一效应后，我们发现平均预测值、不确定性和分歧程度可能相差数个百分点。密度预测可能严重误估"真实"通胀预期，并导致报告的通胀不确定性出现虚假变化。分析表明，可通过多种方式减少此类偏差。

title: Ports, Technology and Inter-City Trade: The Economics and Geopolitics of Evolving Maritime Transport Networks
title_zh: 港口、技术与城市间贸易：演变中的海运网络的经济学与地缘政治
authors: Dávid Krisztián Nagy, Réka Juhász, Claudia Steinwender, Woan Foong Wong, Dávid Krisztián Nagy; Réka Juhász; Claudia Steinwender; Woan Foong Wong
official: 官方在线 2026-07-03 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Maritime transport remains the backbone of global trade, yet the port and shipping network that carries it has been transformed by containerization and related technological advances. Drawing on newly available granular data—digitized historical shipping records, georeferenced ship movements, and shipment-level routing information—we present five stylized facts on the structure and evolution of the maritime network. Global shipping activity is highly concentrated among a changing lineup of dominant top ports even as lower-ranked ports disperse, while state-owned Chinese port terminal operators increasingly account for these global volumes, boosting overall port operations while delivering efficiency gains mostly to Chinese vessels. We use these facts to organize a synthesis of a fast-growing literature: containerization reshaped which port cities could expand, reinforced hub-and-spoke concentration that yields large but localized welfare gains, embedded ports in multimodal networks that amplify the returns to infrastructure, and generated market power, congestion, and environmental costs. Together, this evidence shows how evolving maritime technologies simultaneously deepen global integration and heighten the economic and geopolitical importance of critical nodes in the transport network—and of who controls them.
abstract_zh: 海上运输仍是全球贸易的支柱，但承载这一运输体系的港口与航运网络已因集装箱化及相关技术进步而发生深刻变革。基于新获取的颗粒化数据——数字化历史航运记录、地理参照船舶轨迹及单次货运路径信息——我们归纳出关于海运网络结构与演进的五个典型事实：全球航运活动高度集中于排名动态变化的头部港口，而低排名港口则呈现分散化趋势；同时，中国国有港口码头运营商在全球吞吐量中的占比持续攀升，在提升整体港口运营效率的同时，其效率增益主要惠及中国籍船舶。我们以这些事实为框架，系统梳理了快速发展的相关文献：集装箱化重塑了港口城市的扩张空间，强化了枢纽-辐射式集中格局（虽带来巨大但局部化的福利增益），将港口嵌入多式联运网络（放大基础设施投资回报），并催生了市场势力、拥堵与环境成本问题。这些证据共同表明，不断演进的海运技术在深化全球一体化的同时，也加剧了运输网络关键节点及其控制者的经济与地缘政治重要性。

title: Pricing and Production Without the Invisible Hand
title_zh: 无形之手缺失下的定价与生产
authors: Joel P. Flynn, George Nikolakoudis, Karthik Sastry
official: 官方在线 2026-06-29 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Modern theories of the business cycle do not allow for the simultaneous rational choice of both prices and quantities, instead assuming that an “invisible hand” determines one of these variables to clear markets. In this paper, we develop a macroeconomic model in which both prices and quantities are chosen optimally by firms and exchange is both voluntary and efficient. As a consequence, individual markets will generically be in Walrasian disequilibrium: either slack (over-supplied) or rationed (under-supplied). The absence of market clearing changes pricing and production in qualitatively important ways: markups are governed by the probability of rationing rather than the elasticity of demand, and higher uncertainty reduces production and increases markups. Marrying the Old and New Keynesian traditions, we study general Walrasian disequilibrium with rational expectations and optimal firm decisions. On a technical level, we characterize cross-market spillovers arising from rationed demand with differentiated goods, overcoming the standard combinatorial problem that arises when studying multi-market disequilibrium. Unlike in New Keynesian economies, monetary shocks propagate by reducing product-market slack, raising aggregate labor productivity and consumption with muted effects on employment, while uncertainty shocks act as stagflationary cost-push shocks.
abstract_zh: 现代商业周期理论不允许同时理性选择价格和数量，而是假设“看不见的手”决定其中一个变量以出清市场。本文构建了一个宏观经济模型，其中价格和数量均由企业最优选择，且交换既是自愿的也是有效的。因此，单个市场通常处于瓦尔拉斯非均衡状态：要么松弛（供给过剩），要么配给（供给不足）。市场非出清在本质上改变了定价与生产行为：加成率由配给概率而非需求弹性决定，更高的不确定性会减少产量并提高加成率。融合新旧凯恩斯主义传统，我们研究了具有理性预期和企业最优决策的一般瓦尔拉斯非均衡。在技术层面，我们刻画了差异化商品因配给需求产生的跨市场溢出效应，克服了研究多市场非均衡时面临的标准组合问题。与新凯恩斯主义经济不同，货币冲击通过减少产品市场松弛来传导，从而提高总劳动生产率和消费，但对就业影响有限；而不确定性冲击则表现为滞胀型成本推动冲击。
